scope: Current-source identity algorithms, known divergences, and AR-3 merge-planning boundaries. No merge group, deployed selector, payload value, secret, database row, or cache entry was read.
source_truth_boundary: This is a source-fresh algorithm inventory, not proof that any live selectors are equivalent. AR-1 supplies the redacted read-only baseline; AR-3 applies only operator-approved merge manifests.

confirmed_identity_algorithms.algorithm: ResolveProjectSlug derives a compatibility git slug from normalized origin remote plus repository-relative path; it uses a short SHA-256 prefix. The no-remote path derives a short SHA-256 prefix from absolute cwd and may use the legacy anchor file to stabilize the non-git slug.
confirmed_identity_algorithms.closure_rule: Replacement contract is installed; every named consumer has a nonzero observed denominator or an explicit retirement result; compatibility sunset, rollback evidence, and exact source/configuration scan pass.

confirmed_identity_algorithms.algorithm: ResolveProjectIdentityV2 emits exactly one validated identity source: normalized git remote plus relative path, or a random V2 non-git anchor with explicit shared-state presence. It retains a path-derived legacy selector for compatibility transport.
confirmed_identity_algorithms.closure_rule: Replacement contract is installed; every named consumer has a nonzero observed denominator or an explicit retirement result; compatibility sunset, rollback evidence, and exact source/configuration scan pass.

confirmed_identity_algorithms.algorithm: RegisterAndResolve validates before tenant data access; locks selector and binding identities transactionally; resolves a binding or matching git identity; otherwise creates or binds a projects row and appends owned aliases under the V2 rules.
The server derives p2g or p2n binding keys from a SHA-256 digest of versioned identity source material. Private non-git anchors add legacy selector scope to prevent cross-workspace convergence.
confirmed_identity_algorithms.closure_rule: Replacement contract is installed; every named consumer has a nonzero observed denominator or an explicit retirement result; compatibility sunset, rollback evidence, and exact source/configuration scan pass.

confirmed_identity_algorithms.algorithm: The hook derives a short SHA-256 compatibility slug from origin remote plus relative path, builds and validates a V2 descriptor, and registers it before project-scoped requests. It stores session-start cache entries by a sanitized selector-derived filename.

The OpenClaw plugin computes a compatibility ID from origin remote plus relative path, builds a V2 descriptor for a workspace, and uses registration caches to coalesce first project-scoped registration requests.

confirmed_divergences.finding: Go and the Claude hook use a pure short hash for the git compatibility slug, while OpenClaw prefixes its short hash with a repository-name component.

The Go legacy slug resolver reads or creates the legacy anchor file and can use its non-git stored identity; OpenClaw's legacy ID path derives from resolved workspace path and its V2 route uses a separate V2 anchor file.
Go bounds its two Git calls with one five-second context; the Claude hook and OpenClaw use three-second command timeouts, with the hook asynchronous variant accepting a configurable timeout.

The muxcore compatibility slug cache falls back to its host project ID if legacy slug resolution errors, whereas V2 identity resolution returns the failure to the caller rather than minting a fallback descriptor.
The Claude session-start cache may key by the outer ProjectSelector while its live fetch and emitted records use the registered Project. This is not a canonical identity contract.

requirements: Inventory and normalize identifiers before business-row mutation.
Use an accepted dry-run manifest with per-family counts, conflict dispositions, and redacted fingerprints.
Backfill unresolved rows into a visible quarantine ledger rather than guessing from names or paths.
